hostPolicy.primary: one fixed physical host for every confirmatory block
hostPolicy.cloudRunners: correctness and reproducibility checks only; never pooled with primary timing data
hostPolicy.crossHost: a separately identified replication campaign; never pooled with the primary host

primaryFamilies.outcome: development server cold-start readiness in milliseconds
production build wall time, peak RSS, and CPU seconds from the same invocation

primaryFamilies.samplingUnit: one independently restarted watch session summarized by its measured-update median
one independently restarted browser and development-server session summarized by its measured-update median

secondaryOutcomes.M5-M9: descriptive output-contract measurements from three clean builds per tool and workload; no null-hypothesis tests
secondaryOutcomes.M12: prespecified power-law scaling of M2 over the five synthetic sizes; descriptive slope and bootstrap interval
secondaryOutcomes.allPairwiseComparisons: exploratory; clearly separated from reference-tool confirmatory contrasts

randomization.design: position-balanced randomized complete blocks within metric and workload

cacheAndWarmup.M1: remove declared tool caches and outputs before each process; do not drop operating-system page cache; no timed warmup
cacheAndWarmup.M2-M10-M11: remove declared tool caches and outputs before each process; do not drop operating-system page cache; no timed warmup
cacheAndWarmup.M3-M4: start a fresh session, perform one untimed stabilization edit, then five measured edits with a settled completion condition
cacheAndWarmup.betweenTools: restore byte-identical source and verify process-tree termination before the next scheduled cell

environmentGate.concurrency: no other benchmark cell and no user-initiated heavy workload
preBlock: runtime and lock hashes match the frozen profile
previous benchmark process tree is absent
environmentGate.rule: if a gate fails, postpone the entire block before observing an outcome

allowed: M4 full-page navigation, lost application state, browser error, or failed reload-detector control
forbidden: removal because a value changes a ranking or significance result
mixing a diagnostic, pilot, failed, or superseded campaign into confirmatory data
exclusions.replacement: retain the failed attempt and reason, discard the entire incomplete randomized block from confirmatory inference, and rerun it under a new attempt identifier
exclusions.afterMaximum: pause the affected family and invoke change control; do not silently continue

analysis.contrast: each non-reference tool versus Webpack within the same metric and workload
analysis.test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test over complete blocks
analysis.effect: Hodges-Lehmann paired shift on log outcomes, exponentiated as a typical ratio
analysis.interval: 95% paired-block bootstrap confidence interval with 10000 deterministic resamples
analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across every confirmatory contrast in the metric family
analysis.descriptive: raw observations, failures, block order, median, IQR, and empirical distribution
analysis.M3-M4Reduction: one median per independent session before any inferential analysis
analysis.missingness: complete-block primary analysis; report all missing and replacement attempts
analysis.claimRule: a primary difference claim requires adjusted p < 0.05 and a confidence interval excluding ratio 1; practical magnitude is reported without a post-hoc threshold

changeControl.freeze: commit and hash this protocol and schedule before the first timing observation
changeControl.measurementChange: any runtime, dependency, workload, configuration, collector, completion condition, exclusion, sample-count, or analysis change creates a new protocol version
changeControl.affectedData: observations collected under different protocol versions are never pooled for confirmatory inference
changeControl.unlock: publicationEligible may become true only after the planned matrix is complete, manifests validate, exclusions are audited, and analysis reproduces from the archived corpus
